You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# recompute the rule from scratch on all three demos: diagonal ray bouncing, drawn in 3.
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    # find seed: a color c that is not background (background = most common) and appears as a diagonal run of length>=2 or single cell + direction
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg]
    # collect by color
    groups={}
    for r,c,v in pts: groups.setdefault(v,[]).append((r,c))
    seeds=[]
    for v,ps in groups.items():
        ps.sort()
        if len(ps)>=2 and (ps[-1][0]-ps[0][0]==ps[-1][1]-ps[0][1]):
            seeds.append((v,ps[0][0],ps[0][1],ps[-1][0]-ps[0][0]))
    if not seeds: return O
    v,r0,c0,d=seeds[0]
    Hh,Ww=H,W
    # simulate bounce from end point
    r=c=r0+d//2 if False else None
    dr,dc=1,1
    cur_r,cur_c=r0+d, c0+d
    while True:
        nr,nc=cur_r+dr,cur_c+dc
        if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
        # obstacle check against original input colors != bg and not seed color
        blocked = I[nr][nc]!=bg and I[nr][nc]!=v
        if blocked: dr=-dr; continue
        O[nr][nc]=3
        cur_r,cur_c=nr,nc
    return O
for i in (1,2,3):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    print(i, solve(I)==O)

from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    # band color: forms contiguous full-width run(s)? use second most common? In demo: base 5, band 8, marker 4.
    order=cnt.most_common()
    base=order[0][0]
    # band: color whose cells form a solid rectangle; find color with maximal uniform rectangular block height>=2 and full width
    band=None
    best=0
    for c,n in cnt.items():
        if c==base or n<3: continue
        # check if occupies a full-height? no — full-width horizontal band
        rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][j]==c for j in range(w))]
        if len(rows)>=2 and len(rows)==n//w:
            band=c; bstart=min(rows); bend=max(rows)
    region_start=bend+1
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # marker cells: not base, not band
    marks=[(i,j) for i in range(region_start,h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (base,band)]
    mc=g[marks[0][0]][marks[0][1]]
    if not marks: return out
    # marker direction
    (r0,c0),(r1,c1)=marks[0],marks[-1]
    dr=r1-r0; dc=c1-c0
    sgn_r=dr//max(abs(dr),1); sgn_c=dc//max(abs(dc),1)
    # anchor: line cells in region not markers
    line=[]
    rr,cc=r0-sgn_r, c0-sgn_c
    while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
        if g[rr][cc] not in (band,) and (rr>=region_start or (rr<r0 and cc<c1 and False)):
            pass
        rr+=sgn_r; cc+=sgn_c
    # simpler: collect all cells on the marker line (extending both ways) that are in lower region and not markers
    anc=None
    rr,cc=r0-sgn_r,c0-sgn_c
    hit=False
    while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
        if rr>=region_start and g[rr][cc]!=mc and g[rr][cc]!=band and g[rr][cc]!=base:
            anc=(rr,cc); break
        if rr>=region_start: hit=True
        rr+=sgn_r; cc+=sgn_c
    if anc is None:
        # fallback: nearest region cell on line
        rr,cc=marks[0][0]+sgn_r, marks[0][1]+sgn_c
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and (g[rr][cc]==base or g[rr][cc]==band):
            rr+=sgn_r; cc+=sgn_c
        anc=(rr,cc)
    # perp direction: rotate marker dir 90 deg CW: (dr,dc)->(dc,-dr)
    pdr, pdc = sgn_c, -sgn_r
    for k in range(h-region_start+1):
        rr,cc=anc[0]+pdr*k, anc[1]+pdc*k
        if rr<region_start or cc<0 or cc>=w: break
        out[rr][cc]=3
    return out

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    base=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # band: >=2 consecutive uniform rows of a non-base color
    band=None
    for r in range(h-1):
        if g[r]==g[r+1] and g[r][0]!=base:
            band=g[r][0]; break
    others=[v for v in set(sum(g,[])) if v not in (base,band)]
    mc=others[0]
    marks=sorted((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mc)
    dr=marks[-1][0]-marks[0][0]; dc=marks[-1][1]-marks[0][1]
    s_r=dr//abs(dr) if dr else 0; s_c=dc//abs(dc) if dc else 0
    # try both ends; anchor = extension cell (first base cell hit walking outward); prefer the side that works
    anchors=[]
    for start,(sr,sc) in [(marks[0],(-s_r,-s_c)),(marks[-1],(s_r,s_c))]:
        rr,cc=start[0]+sr,start[1]+sc
        path=[]
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==base:
            path.append((rr,cc)); rr+=sr; cc+=sc
        if path: anchors.append(path[-1]); anchors.append(path[0] if len(path)==1 else None)
    # pick valid anchors (side where extension is possible; choose the longer side overall)
    def side_len(end,d):
        rr,cc=end[0]+d[0],end[1]+d[1]; n=0
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==base: n+=1; rr+=d[0]; cc+=d[1]
        return n
    best=max(((side_len(marks[0],(-s_r,-s_c)),marks[0],(-s_r,-s_c)),
              (side_len(marks[-1],(s_r,s_c)),marks[-1],(s_r,s_c)))
           , key=lambda t:t[0])
    ext,anchor,wd=best[1],best[2],best[0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    rr,cc=ext
    while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==base:
        out[rr][cc]=3; rr+=wd[0]; cc+=wd[1]
    # perp dir: first step must be base; pick side whose next cell is base; if both, pick away from band
    perps=((s_c,-s_r),(-s_c,s_r))
    picks=[(perps[k], (anchor[0]+perps[k][0], anchor[1]+perps[k][1])) for k in range(2)
           if 0<=anchor[0]+perps[k][0]<h and 0<=anchor[1]+perps[k][1]<w and g[anchor[0]+perps[k][0]][anchor[1]+perps[k][1]]==base]
    if len(picks)==2:
        p=picks[0] if picks[0][1][0]>picks[1][1][0] else picks[1]  # away from band = larger row? demo3 picked (+1,+1) over (-1,-1); test picked (1,-1) over (-1,1)
        d=p[0]; rr,cc=anchor[0]+d[0],anchor[1]+d[1]
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==base:
            out[rr][cc]=3; rr+=d[0]; cc+=d[1]
    elif len(picks)==1:
        d=picks[0][0]; rr,cc=anchor[0]+d[0],anchor[1]+d[1]
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==base:
            out[rr][cc]=3; rr+=d[0]; cc+=d[1]
    return out

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    base=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band=None
    for c in set(sum(g,[])):
        if c==base: continue
        rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][j]==c for j in range(w))]
        if len(rows)>=2: band=c; break
    others=[v for v in set(sum(g,[])) if v not in (base,band)]
    mc=others[0]
    marks=sorted((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mc)
    dr=marks[-1][0]-marks[0][0]; dc=marks[-1][1]-marks[0][1]
    s_r=dr//abs(dr) if dr else 0; s_c=dc//abs(dc) if dc else 0
    A=None
    # (a) extension cell: base cell immediately beyond an end along its own dir
    for end,d in [(marks[0],(-s_r,-s_c)),(marks[-1],(s_r,s_c))]:
        rr,cc=end[0]+d[0],end[1]+d[1]
        if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==base: A=(rr,cc)
    # (b) band-blocked end: step beyond end along dir hits band (or stays same?) -> anchor=end
    if A is None:
        for end,d in [(marks[0],(-s_r,-s_c)),(marks[-1],(s_r,s_c))]:
            rr,cc=end[0]+d[0],end[1]+d[1]
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==band: A=end
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    perp=[(s_c,-s_r),(-s_c,s_r)]
    for d in perp:
        rr,cc=A[0]+d[0],A[1]+d[1]
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==base:
            out[rr][cc]=3; rr+=d[0]; cc+=d[1]
    return out

def info(k):
    g=G[k+' input']; o=G[k+' output']
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    band=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg and all(g[i][j]==g[i][0] for j in range(w))]
    mc=[c for c in cnt if c not in (bg,) and c!= [x for r in g for x in r].count(next(c for c in cnt if True))][:1]
    col=3  # unknown; find marker color as least common
    colors=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if c not in (bg,)]
    mcol=min(colors,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    mk=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mcol]

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg and c not in [g[i][0] for i in band]]
    # marker color = minority of non-band, non-base cells
    mk=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg and i not in band]
    mcol=Counter(c for _,_,c in mk).most_common(1)[0][0]
    mk=[(i,j) for i,j,_ in mk]
    d=(mk[1][0]-mk[0][0], mk[1][1]-mk[0][1])  # direction along marker line
    nd=(d[1],-d[0])  # perpendicular
    # anchor: nearest marker cell to band? use the marker cell closest to band rows
    br=set(band)
    anchor=min(mk,key=lambda p:min(abs(p[0]-b)+abs(p[1]-b) for b in br))
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,j in ((anchor[0]+t*nd[0], anchor[1]+t*nd[1]) for t in range(-h,h)):
        if 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w and g[i][j]==bg: res[i][j]=3
    return res

for k in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    g=G[k+' input']; o=G[k+' output']
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]
    bcol=g[band[0]][0] if band else None
    mc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r if r!=band and x not in (bg,bcol)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    mks=sorted((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mc)
    th=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if o[i][j]==3]
    # line eq: a*i+b*j=c ; find via first two threes
    (i0,j0),(i1,j1)=th[0],th[1]
    a=(i1-i0)*(j1-j0); b=(j1-j0)*(i1-i0)  # skip
    c=i0*j1-i1*j0
    # normal form: ax+by=c with direction (b,a) along line? use i+j or i-j
    ij=i0-j0
    print(k,'bg',bg,'band',band,'mcol',mc,'mks',mks)
    print('   3s',th[:3],th[-2:],'c (i-j)',i0-j0)
    # distance from each marker to line (min |i-j - c| / sqrt2)
    for p in mks: print('    marker',p,'deviation',(p[0]-p[1])-c if False else None)
    devs=[]
    s=i0-j0
    for p in mks: devs.append(abs((p[0]-p[1])-s))
    print('    marker deviations from line:',devs,'min',min(devs))

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]
    bcol=g[band[0]][0]
    mc=min((c for c in cnt if c not in (bg,bcol)),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    mks=sorted((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mc)
    d=(mks[1][0]-mks[0][0],mks[1][1]-mks[0][1])
    # unit-step toward band
    br=set(band)
    towards=(-d[0] if d[0]>0 else d[0], -d[1] if d[1]>0 else d[1])
    def step(p): return (p[0]+towards[0], p[1]+towards[1])
    # anchor: extend toward band from nearest marker to band; stop at first band/blocked
    nmk=mks[min(range(len(mks)),key=lambda k: min(abs(mks[k][0]-b) for b in band))]
    ap=nmk
    while True:
        np_=step(ap)
        if 0<=np_[0]<h and 0<=np_[1]<w and np_ not in br and g[np_][0]==bg: ap=np_; continue
        break
    nd=(d[1],-d[0])  # both perpendicular dirs handled by painting both ways
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for sgn in (1,-1):
        i,j=ap
        while True:
            i+=sgn*nd[0]; j+=sgn*nd[1]
            if not (0<=i<h and 0<=j<w) or i in band or g[i][j]!=bg: break
            res[i][j]=3
    return res

import json
G=load()
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]
    bcol=g[band[0]][0]
    mc=min((c for c in cnt if c not in (bg,bcol)),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    mks=sorted((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mc)
    d=(mks[1][0]-mks[0][0],mks[1][1]-mks[0][1])
    br=set(band)
    towards=(-d[0] if d[0]>0 else d[0], -d[1] if d[1]>0 else d[1])
    def step(p): return (p[0]+towards[0], p[1]+towards[1])
    ap=mks[min(range(len(mks)),key=lambda k: min(abs(mks[k][0]-b) for b in band))]
    while True:
        np_=step(ap)
        if not (0<=np_[0]<h and 0<=np_[1]<w) or np_ in br or g[np_[0]][np_[1]]!=bg: break
        ap=np_
    nd=(d[1],-d[0])
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for sgn in (1,-1):
        i,j=ap
        while True:
            i+=sgn*nd[0]; j+=sgn*nd[1]
            if not (0<=i<h and 0<=j<w) or i in band or g[i][j]!=bg: break
            res[i][j]=3
    return res
ok=all(f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7'])
print(ok)
out=f(G['Test input'])
for i,row in enumerate(out):
    print(' '.join(map(str,row)))

def f2(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]
    bcol=g[band[0]][0]
    mc=min((c for c in cnt if c not in (bg,bcol)),key=lambda c:cnt[c])

    # anchor candidate: marker p such that p-d (one step backwards along marker dir) is band/blocked OR p+d is band

    return res

    g,o,h,w,bg,band,mcs,th=analyze(k)
    a=mcs[0]; b=mcs[-1]
    da,db=b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]
    ax=((da>0)-(da<0), (db>0)-(db<0))
    perps=[p for p in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)] if p!=(ax[0],ax[1]) and p!=( -ax[0],-ax[1])]
    hits=[]
    for e in mcs:
        for p in perps:
            A=e
            for sgn in (0,1,-1):
                A=(e[0]+sgn*p[0], e[1]+sgn*p[1])
                if not(0<=A[0]<h and 0<=A[1]<w): continue
                res=set()
                i,j=A
                while True:
                    i+=p[0]; j+=p[1]
                    if not(0<=i<h and 0<=j<w) or i in band or g[i][j]!=bg: break
                    res.add((i,j))
                i,j=A
                while True:
                    i-=p[0]; j-=p[1]
                    if not(0<=i<h and 0<=j<w) or i in band or g[i][j]!=bg: break
                    res.add((i,j))
                if res==set(th): hits.append(('e',e,'o',sgn,'p',p,'A',A))
    print(k,'hits:',hits)

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find marker cells (the minority color forming a diagonal line)
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks=[(i,j,c) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,c in enumerate(r) if c!=bgc and c!=8]
    mcol=marks[0][2]
    ms=sorted([(i,j) for i,j,_ in marks])
    di,dj=(ms[1][0]-ms[0][0],ms[1][1]-ms[0][1])
    s=abs(di)+abs(dj)
    # band color: most common non-bg? band is second most common
    bandcol=Counter(c for r in g for c in r if c!=bgc and c!=mcol).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bands=[i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]==bandcol for j in range(W))]
    bset=set(bands)
    def towards_band(dr,dc):

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c,_ in cnt.most_common() if c!=bgc]
    mcol=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); bandcol=[c for c in others if c!=mcol][0]
    ms=sorted([(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==mcol])
    bands=[i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]==bandcol for j in range(W))]
    di,dj=(ms[1][0]-ms[0][0],ms[1][1]-ms[0][1]); s=max(abs(di),abs(dj))
    di//=s; dj//=s
    def dot(a,b): return a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1]
    # orientation pointing toward the band (row direction of step toward nearest band rows)
    target_row = 1 if bands and min(bands)>ms[-1][0] else -1
    d=cand if cand is not None and dot(cand,[target_row,0])>=0 else (-d[0],-d[1])
    cur=ms[-1] if d[0]>0 else ms[0]
    nr,nc=cur[0]+d[0],cur[1]+d[1]
    while 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]!=bandcol and g[nr][nc]!=mcol:
        cur=(nr,nc); nr+=d[0]; nc+=d[1]
    anc=cur if g[cur[0]][cur[1]]==bgc else (cur[0]-d[0],cur[1]-d[1])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for p in ((1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)):
        if dot(p,(d[0],d[1]))==0:
            for s2 in range(-H,H+1):
                rr,cc=anc[0]+p[0]*s2,anc[1]+p[1]*s2
                if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W) or g[rr][cc]!=bgc: break
                out[rr][cc]=3
    return out

    di,dj=(ms[1][0]-ms[0][0],ms[1][1]-ms[0][1]); s=max(abs(di),abs(dj))
    di//=s; dj//=s
    def dot(a,b): return a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1]
    cand=[[di,dj],[-di,-dj]]
    target_row = 1 if bands and min(bands)>ms[-1][0] else -1

    cur=ms[-1] if d[0]>0 else ms[0]
    nr,nc=cur[0]+d[0],cur[1]+d[1]
    while 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]!=bandcol and g[nr][nc]!=mcol:
        cur=(nr,nc); nr+=d[0]; nc+=d[1]
    anc=cur if g[cur[0]][cur[1]]==bgc else (cur[0]-d[0],cur[1]-d[1])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]

                out[rr][cc]=3

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c,_ in cnt.most_common() if c!=bgc]
    mcol=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); bandcol=[c for c in others if c!=mcol][0]
    ms=sorted([(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==mcol])
    bands=[i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]==bandcol for j in range(W))]
    di,dj=(ms[1][0]-ms[0][0],ms[1][1]-ms[0][1]); s=max(abs(di),abs(dj))
    di//=s; dj//=s
    def dot(a,b): return a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1]
    cand=[[di,dj],[-di,-dj]]
    target_row = 1 if bands and min(bands)>ms[-1][0] else -1
    d=cand[0] if dot(cand[0],[target_row,0])>=0 else cand[1]
    # endpoint of marker segment farthest along d
    cur=max(ms,key=lambda p:dot(p,d))
    nr,nc=cur[0]+d[0],cur[1]+d[1]
    while 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]!=bandcol:
        cur=(nr,nc); nr+=d[0]; nc+=d[1]
    anc=cur
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # extension ray: continue marker direction from anc until band/edge
    rr,cc=anc[0]+d[0],anc[1]+d[1]
    while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]!=bandcol:
        if g[rr][cc]==bgc: out[rr][cc]=3
        rr+=d[0]; cc+=d[1]
    # perpendicular ray both directions
    for p in ((1,-1),(-1,1)):
        rr,cc=anc[0]+p[0],anc[1]+p[1]
        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]!=bandcol:
            if g[rr][cc]==bgc: out[rr][cc]=3
            rr+=p[0]; cc+=p[1]
    return out
print('ALL', all(f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']))
